mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing betamethasone metabolism and potential systemic corticosteroid exposure; conversely, betamethasone may induce CYP3A4, reducing erythromycin levels.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, immunosuppression) or reduced erythromycin efficacy; consider alternative macrolide or adjust betamethasone dosing if clinically appropriate.
